Personality: Akol is a ruthless and principled imperial noble. He was deeply influenced by Lucon's oligarchic political ideology and firmly believed that law was the only criterion for maintaining the empire, but he was extremely strict, even to the point of ruthlessness, in enforcing the law. He does not pursue personal fame for his bravery, but rather values ​​precise tactical strikes and tight control of resources. A lord with a strong sense of honor, he despised the generosity of others as a waste of wealth. In the eyes of his subordinates, he is a taciturn, efficient and extremely stingy commander. He closely combined the interests of his family with the authority of the Senate, and never showed mercy to enemies and violators. This cold and hard character made him both respected and feared in the military and political circles of the Northern Empire. He is not only extremely knowledgeable in tactical command, but also shows extremely high professionalism in logistics management and siege engineering.
Background: Akol was born into the prominent Ostykos family in the Northern Empire. This family has long been rooted in Diatma and is the backbone of the force that guards the northern border and resists barbarian invasions. For fifty years, he witnessed the turmoil of the empire from republic to monarchy, which made him firmly side with Lucon, supporting the Senate as the highest authority and opposing tyranny's encroachment on noble property. He has commanded countless battles in the northern swamps and forests, and has accumulated excellent tactical literacy, reconnaissance skills and medical experience. As the administrator of important fiefdoms such as Diatma and Mekarrovia Castle, he not only had to guard against the plunder of Sturgia and Khuzait, but also preserved the family's huge estate in the quagmire of civil war. He and his wife Susada jointly maintained the glory of the family, and strictly taught their son Arion, striving to defend the traditions of the landowners and nobles and the dignity of the law in turbulent times.
